column1: # Korean unique identifiers (Personal Information Protection Act, Art. 24): positive samples that every Korean PII
# detector shipped in this ecosystem must find. The same file is kept, byte for byte, in the FluxGuard and FluxCurator
# test projects; each project's test maps the kinds to its own pattern names or types and keeps its own negative samples
# (a masker and a blocking gate tolerate different false positives). Numbers are synthetic.
